market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely volatile in 1-3 month window. Oil at $100 and Hormuz risk support energy but fuel rate-hike fears, pressuring banks and property. Iron ore weakness caps materials. Gold and energy outperform; banks and REITs underperform. S&P/ASX 200 range-bound with downside risk if RBA signals hawkish pivot.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Property credit cycle turning and consumer stress (second jobs, cost creep) cap earnings growth. Iron ore structural decline pressures BHP/RIO/FMG. Gold and energy offer relative strength. RBA likely to hold or hike once, then cut in H2 2026 if oil normalises. Construction/infrastructure policy support (6,000 tradies scheme) provides modest tailwind.
